attempts.response:
```sql
WITH
-- Align 2023 and 2024 centre names
centre_mapping AS (
    SELECT
        a."Centre" AS centre_2023,
        b."centre_name" AS centre_2024,
        jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."Centre")), lower(trim(b."centre_name"))) AS similarity
    FROM "attendance_2023" a
    CROSS JOIN "attendance_2024" b
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Centre" ORDER BY similarity DESC) = 1
),

-- Get best matches (left join to keep all 2023 centres)
matched_centres AS (
    SELECT
        a."Centre" AS centre_2023,
        COALESCE(b."centre_name", a."Centre") AS centre_2024
    FROM "attendance_2023" a
    LEFT JOIN centre_mapping m ON a."Centre" = m.centre_2023
    LEFT JOIN "attendance_2024" b ON m.centre_2024 = b."centre_name"
),

-- Calculate monthly averages for each year
yearly_averages AS (
    SELECT
        centre_2023 AS "Centre",
        AVG("Avg Daily Present"::FLOAT / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids"::FLOAT, 0)) * 100 AS "2023 Avg Monthly Attendance %"
    FROM "attendance_2023"
    GROUP BY centre_2023

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        centre_2024 AS "Centre",
        AVG(average_attendance::FLOAT / NULLIF(enrolment::FLOAT, 0)) * 100 AS "2024 Avg Monthly Attendance %"
    FROM "attendance_2024"
    GROUP BY centre_2024
)

-- Final comparison with both years
SELECT
    "Centre",
    "2023 Avg Monthly Attendance %",
    "2024 Avg Monthly Attendance %"
FROM yearly_averages
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Centre" ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN "Centre" LIKE '%2023%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
) = 1
ORDER BY "Centre";
```
